test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per India Census 2011, which of the 22 languages specified in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India is spoken by least number of people?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanskrit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In all, **13 of the 22 scheduled languages** had at least 1% of the population reporting them as their mother tongue.
 
• Except for Sanskrit, each of the 21 listed languages has at least 10 lakh people reporting it as their mother tongue.</li
